title: The metabob cockpit tool registry_query answers "No vessels advertise shape X" for shapes that discovery does serve. Mea
description: The metabob cockpit tool registry_query answers "No vessels advertise shape X" for shapes that discovery does serve. Measured twice: memoryNote (discovery /registry/shapes lists it; vesselCapability resolve returns development-vessel-local) and source_code/problem_detection/code_quality (all resolve to analysis-vessel-local, 6 shapes, registered among 14 vessels, health 200). It advertises ~90 shapes against discovery /registry/stats totalShapes=383, so it appears to read a partial or stale index. IMPACT: this is the read path for law 3 (find an existing producer before minting) — a false negative is exactly what causes a duplicate mint, which the laws call negative value. It has already produced a wrong finding in a documentation audit, where an agent concluded a running, registered vessel advertised nothing. Consumers must cross-check against discovery /resolve before concluding absence.
